name: MeshClient
description: A Meshtastic client for your handheld: read and send messages, browse the mesh, and edit your radio's settings over Bluetooth LE or USB.
author: mcereal

changelog.v2.9.0: Say which cached nodes the radio has forgotten, and offer to drop them; Count what a forget removes, not what is cached or stale.
changelog.v2.8.0: Give the conversation list avatars, and X to delete a thread.
changelog.v2.7.0: Hold the d-pad to scroll a long list; End a held direction when its device goes away.
changelog.v2.6.0: Keep NeighborInfo, and draw the mesh as a graph; Accept the two text ports we dropped, and ask nodes for readings; Keep the node telemetry, packet fields and reactions we were dropping; Keep the three FromRadio variants we were dropping; Four gaps in the batch that Codex review caught.
changelog.v2.5.0: Pick the theme from Settings; Keep the bypass PAT off disk during dependency setup; Repaint on the press, and keep an explicit capture scale.
